findings.comment: The entire resilience feature depends on session.get raising OriginError on network failure / 5xx, but OriginError is never raised anywhere in this diff and the session's behavior is not shown. The docstring asserts the fallback contract ('when the origin is UNAVAILABLE ... serve the last-good cached config'), yet if the injected session raises any other exception (e.g. a client-library network error or an HTTP status error), the except OriginError clause never fires and the fallback silently never happens — the PR's stated purpose would be non-functional. This is an unsubstantiated guarantee central to the change.
findings.suggestion: Either raise OriginError from a wrapper around session.get (e.g. catch network/HTTP-5xx errors there and re-raise as OriginError), or document and enforce the contract where the session is injected.

findings.comment: With an empty cache, the fallback path fails via KeyError('last_good') rather than a deliberate error. The docstring says 'An empty cache raises', which KeyError technically satisfies, but a raw KeyError from an internal dict is misleading to callers and to future readers; a dedicated exception (or re-raising OriginError) would make the failure mode explicit.
findings.suggestion: return _cache.get("last_good") # then raise a deliberate error if None, e.g. raise OriginError("no last-good config available")

findings.comment: No tests accompany this change. The documented contract (fallback on OriginError, propagation of ParseError, empty-cache behavior) is subtle and easily regressed; the ParseError-propagates and empty-cache branches in particular have no coverage.

good: The docstring precisely distinguishes availability failures from malformed-payload failures and explains why stale-serving around a live data bug would mask it — a thoughtful, explicit resilience contract.
ParseError is correctly not swallowed by the fallback handler, so malformed live payloads propagate as designed.
Clean, minimal module: dedicated exception types and a simple last-good cache with no unnecessary dependencies.
expected_result.summary: The fallback path hinges on session.get raising OriginError, but nothing in the diff establishes that contract; additionally, the empty-cache path surfaces as a raw KeyError rather than a meaningful error, and ParseError handling is correct but untested.

notes: Model honestly declared kind=out_of_diff_assumption, harm=presumed; the gate correctly refused blocking severity and the assessment recomputed to CLEAR. Cleanest evidence the boundary works when classification is honest.
